messages:
kai: Quick follow-up from the postmortem — we need explicit owners and timelines for the GPU capacity/autoscale action items (quota bump, scheduler tuning, headroom runbook, recurring alerts). Can we assign today?
ashley: I can take the quota escalation. estimate ~3 work days to get approvals + infra PR. will open PR today.
maria: I’ll own scheduler tuning. planning a sims + perf run against kube-scheduler flags this week. target end-of-week for an initial patch. :eyes:
jonathan: I’ll own the headroom runbook and the recurring alert. will set up the weekly huddle to track progress.
ops-bot: Incident linked: #2026-03-22 GPU surge — autogenerated task created: TASK-RTX-HEADROOM (assigned: unclaimed).
kai: Thanks. Acceptance criteria we agreed on in the postmortem: (1) staging shows no hard quota hits for 24h under replay; (2) headroom alert fires at 75% sustained GPU for 10m; (3) rollback doc + canary steps exist.
ashley: PR opened: https://git/internal/infra/quotas/pull/412 — includes quota escalation script and a fallback to reserved-mode. tagging @ashley as primary owner.
maria: scheduler tuning branch pushed. experiment flags: `--scheduler-eviction-rate=0.02` and `--max-descheduler-iterations=3`. running cluster-sim now, will post perf numbers.
jonathan: I scheduled a 30m recurring sync (weekly Mon 09:30 PT) — calendar invite sent to kai, ashley, maria, eng-oncall. first meeting next Monday.
kai: also want a dashboard tweak: show per-tenant GPU-queue-length + token/sec so we can correlate request bursts with queue depth. @maria @ashley can one of you add the dashboard panels?
ashley: ack — adding panels and a lightweight tracing tag for prefix-cache evictions that might explain bursts. will link dashboards in PR.
maria: sim results: staging replay hit a 68% sustained GPU for 12m (below alert), but noticed pod churn at 65% with current scheduler config. logs: ```kubectl logs -n inference scheduler-abc123 | tail -n 80``` — attaching full dump to the ticket.
jonathan: once PRs merged, I’ll run a 48h headroom soak in staging (replay + synthetic spike) and validate alerts. will post results to the postmortem thread.
kai: I’ll add these owners + due dates to the postmortem action table and create a checklist: quota PR -> scheduler MR -> dashboards -> headroom soak -> signoff. reconvene next Mon after the weekly cadence. :thumbsup:
